name: wastewater-benchmark
description:
Benchmark for Wastewater Systems
This dataset was made for Graph Neural Networks, and is focused on monitoring wastewater networks. 
This dataset was made using a network based a city in the Netherlands. It contains the results
of 256000 simulations with different paramaters that were created using AutoDesk's InfoWorks ICM. The parameters
are the following:

10 different rainfalls
Conduit Roughness type (top and bottom): Colebrook-White (CW)
Conduit Roughness value (top and bottom): 0.25-8.00… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/joren-h/wastewater-benchmark.
reputation: A specialized GNN benchmark for wastewater network simulation; used in niche research on infrastructure modeling but not widely adopted outside that community.
